name: @ljie-pi/ghc-gateway
description: A local gateway for GitHub Copilot-compatible APIs
author: ljie-PI

scripts.build: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/clean_admin_build.ts all && node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/generate_migrations.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/generate_migrations.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sdk.json --noEmit && svelte-check --tsconfig web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/generate_migrations.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:sdk: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/require_opt_in.ts GHC_GATEWAY_SDK_TESTS && vitest run --config vitest.sdk.config.ts
scripts.test:live:sdk: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/require_opt_in.ts GHC_GATEWAY_LIVE_TESTS && vitest run --config vitest.sdk.config.ts
scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/pack.ts
scripts.typecheck:sdk: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/require_opt_in.ts GHC_GATEWAY_SDK_TESTS && tsc -p tsconfig.sdk.json --noEmit
scripts.web:build: node scripts/refactor/bootstrap.mjs scripts/refactor/clean_admin_build.ts && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
